text.text: NetApp offers a range of storage media from high-capacity to high-performing disk drives plus self-encrypting drives and extreme performance options using solid state technology. We are also a leader in using Flash technology to optimize storage cost and performance. The NetApp Virtual Storage Tier promotes “hot” data to Flash media in real time and leaves the original copy on disk. This approach improves performance while reducing cost by using fewer, larger disk drives. NetApp disk shelves deliver: Enterprise-class resiliency and availability Flexibility to use across FAS and V-Series storage systems Nondisruptive controller upgrades, protecting your investment Industry-leading storage efficiency with the NetApp Data ONTAP ® operating system
